basinSource: BasinATLAS v1.0 level 04; CC BY 4.0; published Europe display mask and identifiers
riverSource: Natural Earth v5.1.2 50m rivers, selected lines; see context-v1/manifest.json
method: Group only identical MAIN_BAS identifiers, follow NEXT_DOWN to the same outlet; do not merge adjacent polygons. Compare the existing river line endpoints with the published basin grid.
limitations: The Europe grid is a clipped display mask, not original basin geometry.
The stored river lines may start downstream of the source.
A complete source river and uncut whole-basin polygon need independent verification before the screen can say 全流域・本流・河口.

proposedWholeBasinSource.product: HydroATLAS BasinATLAS v1.0, global level-04 shapefile
proposedWholeBasinSource.existingProof: data-source/atlas/europe/drainage/selected-inputs.json pins original level-04 SHP/DBF/PRJ/SHX hashes and the archive entry ranges; the raw files are not retained in this workspace.
proposedWholeBasinSource.nextValidation: Reacquire the same pinned source entries through an authorized normal download, dissolve every polygon with the verified MAIN_BAS, check that the complete geometry lies inside the map frame, and publish an uncut basin view with its modification and scale recorded.
proposedWholeBasinSource.status: The existing published 45-country raster cannot recover polygon parts removed by the country mask. Normal access to the official Figshare download and API returned HTTP 403 in this environment.

proposedFullMainstemSource.product: HydroATLAS RiverATLAS v1.0, global shapefile with regional tiles
proposedFullMainstemSource.databaseLicense: CC BY 4.0 for the HydroATLAS collective database; check the RiverATLAS catalog for the exact licenses of the topology columns before distributing derived attributes.
proposedFullMainstemSource.namedAnchorCandidate: Natural Earth 1:10m rivers and lake centerlines: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/10m-physical-vectors/10m-rivers-lake-centerlines/ . Its named segments must be checked against the RiverATLAS outlet and course; a label match alone does not verify a complete mainstem.
proposedFullMainstemSource.method: Identify the outlet from the verified named river and mouth, select its MAIN_RIV network, verify every NEXT_DOWN path reaches the outlet, then trace contiguous ORD_CLAS=1 backbone reaches from source to mouth. Check the displayed reach endpoints and junctions against the source geometry; do not label an unverified longest path as the named mainstem.
proposedFullMainstemSource.status: Official shapefile is not present; a normal request to the official Figshare API returned HTTP 403 in this environment. No RiverATLAS geometry or topology is published yet.

separateHydroRiversBoundary: The HydroRIVERS standalone product has different redistribution terms; this review does not relicense or republish it as RiverATLAS.
